mapper.sql: USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, EMP_NO, USER_GROUP_NO, USER_TYPE_CD, EMAIL, PHONE_NO, CELL_PHONE_NO, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NAME, BRANCH_CD, USER_POSITION, LAST_LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_FLAG, LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, LOCK_YN, PW_EXPIRE_DT, INFO_CHG_DT, USE_YN, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM T_USER
ORDER BY USER_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME, u.PASSWORD, u.EMP_NO, u.USER_GROUP_NO, u.USER_TYPE_CD, u.EMAIL, u.PHONE_NO, u.CELL_PHONE_NO, u.DEPT_CD, u.DEPT_NAME, u.BRANCH_CD, u.USER_POSITION, u.LAST_LOGIN_DT, u.LOGIN_FLAG, u.LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, u.LOCK_YN, u.PW_EXPIRE_DT, u.INFO_CHG_DT, u.USE_YN, u.REG_DT, u.REG_ID, u.UPD_DT, u.UPD_ID, g.USER_GROUP_NAME, ga.AUTH_CODE FROM T_USER u LEFT JOIN T_USER_GROUP g ON u.USER_GROUP_NO = g.USER_GROUP_NO LEFT JOIN T_USER_GROUP_AUTH ga ON g.USER_GROUP_NO = ga.USER_GROUP_NO WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_USER ( USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, EMP_NO, USER_GROUP_NO, USER_TYPE_CD, EMAIL, PHONE_NO, CELL_PHONE_NO, DEPT_CD, DEPT_NAME, BRANCH_CD, USER_POSITION, USE_YN, LOCK_YN, LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, LOGIN_FLAG, REG_DT, REG_ID ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{empNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userGroupNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userTypeCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phoneNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cellPhoneNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{branchCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userPosition,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'Y'), 'N', 0, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, #{regId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_USER SET PASSWORD = #{password}, PW_EXPIRE_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '90' DAY, LOCK_YN = 'N', LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0, INFO_CHG_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE T_USER SET LAST_LOGIN_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, LOGIN_FLAG = 'Y', LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE T_USER SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = NVL(LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, 0) + 1, LOCK_YN = CASE WHEN NVL(LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, 0) + 1 >= 5 THEN 'Y' ELSE LOCK_YN END WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE T_USER SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
